new_value: Specified §8.13.3 subject DN and SAN criticality: subject DN SHOULD be empty sequence (identity carried by key+SAN, not DN; issuers MAY add display DN but verifiers MUST NOT use it as identity input); empty subject => SAN MUST be critical per RFC 5280 §4.1.2.6/§4.2.1.6; non-empty subject => SAN REQUIRED, MAY be non-critical. Edge-cases review found issuer/verifier asymmetry (criticality was issuer-facing only) — added verifier-side MUST-reject for empty-subject + non-critical-SAN to the acceptance paragraph; re-review PASS (full 6-case subject/SAN matrix verified).
